sources.excerpt: We've done carbon capture for all of @SearchPilot emissions since the company was formed. In the first few years, we spent a fair bit of money on carbon accounting to figure out how much we needed to buy. A couple of years ago, I took the decision to stop doing that and just scale up our capture purchases using the information that we'd had about carbon emissions per head and per unit of revenue, and put the money we saved into capturing even more emissions. At a recent company offsite, someone asked if that was still appropriate in an era of heavy AI use, and I did a bit of research. I thought others might be interested to know what I found, which was that AI carbon emissions might account…
